source: A ZXNAME0000XZ kernel launch creates a grid of thread blocks. Each block contains threads, and blocks are scheduled onto Streaming Multiprocessors (ZXNAME0001XZ). Once resident, the threads of a block are partitioned into 32-thread warps on ZXNAME0002XZ hardware.[1]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 内核启动会创建线程块网格。每个块都包含线程，并且块被调度到流多处理器（ZXNAME0001XZ）上。一旦驻留，块的线程将被划分为 ZXNAME0002XZ 硬件上的 32 线程扭曲。[1]
